as_told.title: Beehive-like craft interior
as_told.place_text: aboard craft near November 5, South Dakota

plain: A former nuclear missile security guard named Mario Woods says he was taken aboard a craft in South Dakota and saw an inside like a beehive, with "multi levels" and "all these small Grays everywhere going to and fro". The Grays are small grey-skinned beings, the classic picture of an alien. Woods tells it twice on Michels's show: in one telling he also describes being held in a pyramid-shaped field, and in the other he dates the event to 1977 and leaves out the pyramid.
